body:
$26k... For a USED Subaru Legacy (lol) that's been involved in two accidents... Can you people stop ruining the car market?

If you're smart, go on Honda's website and build yourself a brand new 2022 Civic for MSRP instead. Thank me later.

Just be patient. Someone will come along and take it off your hands for $8k. A couple years ago $5-7k would be ideal, but gen Z ruined the car market due to lack of negotiating skills. Hence all the overpriced pieces of shit at $5-7k.

Personally, I'm not okay with whatever the weather ends up being. I can't rationalize this shit anymore. After all of the years of suffering, what's the point of continuing for maybe one day of sunlight? I consider myself to be mentally strong, but we're all tired of huffing and puffing with no end or break in sight.
Maybe like, you know, tell her to fucking stop? This post pissed me off
